message.content: {"skills": [{"slot": 1, "name": "配置 Scrapy Feed 导出", "description": "通过 FEEDS 及相关设置配置 Scrapy 抓取结果的导出目标、序列化格式与存储后端。适用于需要将抓取到的 item 持久化到文件、FTP、S3、GCS 或标准输出的场景。", "asset_type": "session_skill", "asset_node_id": "workflow_skill", "granularity": "session", "objective": "按目标存储与格式正确配置 feed 导出并产出可用的导出配置", "domain": "scrapy", "task_family": "数据导出配置", "method_family": "settings 配置", "stage": "导出配置", "use_when": ["需要把抓取结果写入文件或云存储", "需要选择 JSON/CSV/XML 等导出格式"], "do_not_use_when": ["仅需内存中处理 item 而不落盘", "未确定导出目标与格式"], "success_artifact": "一份包含 FEEDS 及必要导出设置的可用配置", "why_distinct": "覆盖导出配置的整体工作流，区别于单个设置项或插件细节", "evidence_span_hint": "Settings\nThese are the settings used for configuring the feed exports", "confidence": 0.7}, {"slot": 2, "name": "Feed 导出设置项参考", "description": "列出并说明配置 feed 导出所用的各项设置（FEEDS、FEED_EXPORT_ENCODING、FEED_STORE_EMPTY、FEED_EXPORT_FIELDS、FEED_EXPORT_INDENT、FEED_STORAGES、FEED_EXPORTERS、FEED_EXPORT_BATCH_ITEM_COUNT 等）的含义与用途。", "asset_type": "knowledge_reference", "asset_node_id": "knowledge_reference_node", "granularity": "macro", "objective": "提供 feed 导出相关设置项的查阅参考", "domain": "scrapy", "task_family": "配置参考", "method_family": "设置项说明", "stage": "查阅", "use_when": ["需要确认某个导出设置项的名称或作用"], "do_not_use_when": ["需要端到端配置流程而非单项说明"], "success_artifact": "可定位到具体设置项及其用途的参考信息", "why_distinct": "为参考型知识资产，不直接执行配置动作", "evidence_span_hint": "- `FEEDS` (mandatory)\n- `FEED_EXPORT_ENCODING`", "confidence": 0.6}]}
